baseline_models.mechanism: A synchronized departure at the opening of day is carried by settled aim and culminates in the actors' sense that their intention can be converted into control.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional stance عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ can carry withholding, while قَادِرِينَ can carry both power and constriction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Withholding is not merely the intended object; it is the footing of their action. Their capacity consists in making another's share narrow, so power and scarcity occupy the same root sequence.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and contracted refusal supply the operative disposition carried by عَلَىٰ.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَرْدٍ admits anger as well as intent, and قَادِرِينَ admits deliberate arrangement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The departure can be affectively charged: irritation hardens into a plan, and planning gives anger a practical route into action.

activation_trace.role: Morning departure supplies the rapid conversion of disposition into movement.

baseline_models.mechanism: The group can be heard as moving with an uneven or constrained gait while still placing itself in a measured, controlled formation. Apparent mastery therefore contains bodily strain from the start.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, oath, cutting, exception, secrecy, entry, and poverty; I infer a causal chain in which secrecy enables exclusion and exclusion is counted as ability. A live alternative is that secrecy marks only haste or embarrassment, while capability remains generic.

changed_reading.after: They depart under an exclusion protocol, treating the engineered denial of another's share as the very content of being capable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The restrictive force they intend to direct outward returns upon their own yield and perception. A surrounding visitation leaves a severed remnant; seeing produces not mastery but loss, and intended deprivation ends in their own deprivation.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encompassing motion, severance, seeing, loss, and deprivation; I infer that the intended arrow of constriction rebounds from the poor onto the planners. Alternatively, the event can be read as simple interruption rather than a formally mirrored operation.

changed_reading.after: قَادِرِينَ becomes locally sincere but globally ironic: the constrictive power they claim has already operated against them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural actors initially look like one capable body, but the aftermath differentiates a just middle voice, mutually facing parts, blame, admission of excess, and a wish for replacement. Their collective capacity is therefore a temporary coalition, not a uniform interior state.

structural_cues: The focus verse uses plural movement and plural capability without naming individual positions.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a middle member, partition, confrontation, blame, excess, and replacement; I infer that the unified capability of 68:25 suppresses live internal difference. Alternatively, the differences may arise only after failure and need not have existed during departure.

changed_reading.after: A coalition performs unanimity at departure, while the later fracture reveals unequal judgment and different capacities for correction within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owners' practical power shades into unauthorized jurisdiction. Later questions about judgment, binding inscription, oaths, and a guarantor expose the missing warrant behind their confidence: they act as if capacity itself grants the right to allocate access.

changed_reading.before: They believe they can execute a private plan.
changed_reading.after: They behave as self-authorized allocators, mistaking the ability to enforce a distribution for the right to judge who receives it.

strongest_changes: حَرْدٍ and قَادِرِينَ converge on a model in which the production of scarcity is mistaken for effective capacity.
The deprivation intended for the poor rebounds onto the planners, making their capability sincere at the local moment but ironic in the completed sequence.
Later inability to lower the body distinguishes capacity for domination from capacity for responsive submission.
The plural group fractures after failure, revealing that its performed unanimity concealed unequal judgment and corrigibility.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse behaves like a compressed hinge: aim, withholding, anger, gait, measure, power, and planning coexist in three roots, while the surrounding sequence sends each mechanism in more than one direction. The odd food, weather, and footing branches remain productive when contained as image-patterns rather than forced translations.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether حَرْدٍ primarily coordinates intent, withholding, anger, or a deliberate polysemy cannot be settled by the packet alone.
The legal-warrant and inscription models may be whole-surah analogies rather than direct mechanisms internal to the garden episode.
The gait, cloud, and meal readings are branch-backed but form-distant and should remain exploratory.
Later group differentiation does not prove that disagreement was already conscious at the moment of departure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Morning resolve coupled to claimed capacity.** `غ د و B001` supplies early setting-out, `ح ر د B001` earnest intention, and `ق د ر B003/B005` effective control and deliberative planning. The circumstantial *qādirīn* presents capacity as their own assessment while they travel. I infer planned intention -> felt mastery; the ayah captures confidence immediately before perception disproves it.
2. **Angry withdrawal and narrowed measure.** `ح ر د B003/B004` supplies aggression and withdrawal apart; `ق د ر B004` supplies constriction to a scant measure. Their plan is to isolate the field's benefit from the poor. I infer social withdrawal narrows distribution; the line can therefore read “intent on exclusion and able,” while preserving the darker irony that their own allotment has already been narrowed.
3. **Drying yield under an image of power.** `ح ر د B005` supplies drying or stoppage of milk/rain. In proximity to the ruined garden and `ق د ر B001` measured extent, I infer the field's yield has been stopped to a measure outside their estimate. *Ḥard* thus preserves both their intention and the material barrenness that defeats it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:26 is the immediate surprise: claimed capacity cannot even secure recognition of the place. The later questions about judgment, oaths, partners, and the unseen (68:36-47) expand the same error from control over a garden to control over final outcomes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **They set out on withheld yield and arrive at withheld yield.** Fixed `حَرْد` activates `ح ر د B001` (earnest aim) and `ح ر د B005` (milk or rain drying up, yield withheld). The ruined crop in 68:20, exclusion order in 68:24, and recognition of deprivation in 68:27 supply material and social withholding; I infer a reversal from their aim to withhold produce to produce being withheld from them. `عَلَى حَرْد` can therefore name both intention and the barren condition carrying them.
2. **Capacity narrowed by the act of narrowing provision.** Fixed `قَادِرِينَ` activates `ق د ر B003` (effective capacity) and `ق د ر B004` (narrowing to a scant measure). Their confident departure and immediate inability to obtain the crop supply the reversal; I infer that constricting another's provision causes their practical capacity to contract. The adjective reads ironically as power already turning into limitation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:27 confirmed that fixed `حَرْد` had already named withheld yield (`ح ر د B005`) beneath the owners' intent. Their claim to capacity was retrospectively corrected into narrowed provision (`ق د ر B004`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] The Orchard Moves from Assay to Cultivation, Cutting, and Meal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Productive value is disclosed through a staged cycle: weathering and test, prepared soil, ripened growth, harvest, and consumption.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The owners are themselves processed like the orchard: wear and testing reveal condition, while planning, cutting, and morning consumption specify the material sequence they try to control.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ripened Growth Is Cut into Shares
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The crop reaches cutting-time, is severed from its plant, and becomes a field of pieces that can be gathered, divided, and carried.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting and separation (`quranic:root_000861:B001/m01`); palm harvest (`quranic:root_000861:B002/m01`); harvested field or cut portion (`quranic:root_000861:B005/m01`); separated share (`quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`); woven palm container for fresh dates (`quranic:root_000464:B010/m01`); measured limit (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`); planned and fitted operation (`quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Harvest translates living continuity into countable portions. The cut, cleared field, allocated share, carrying basket, measured limit, and prior plan expose exactly where distributive justice could enter the production sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Morning Converts Harvest into a Scheduled Meal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dawn sets the work-time; arrival in the morning is coordinated with a first meal, drink, and cooking vessel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: first light (`quranic:root_000839:B001/m01`); morning arrival (`quranic:root_000839:B002/m01`); morning drink or food (`quranic:root_000839:B003/m01`); becoming in the morning (`quranic:root_000839:B010/m01`); early departure (`quranic:root_001076:B001/m01`); breakfast (`quranic:root_001076:B004/m01`); day-cutting meal (`quranic:root_000861:B009/m01`); cooking pot and prepared food (`quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Morning is an operational clock joining departure, cutting, drink, meal, and cooking. The ruined orchard interrupts not only ownership but the timed conversion of crop into daily sustenance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Water and Milk Must Keep Moving Through a Managed Circuit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A living resource remains productive only when rain, stored water, pasture, herd movement, and milk transfer continue through connected stages.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The garden’s loss is reframed as a broken hydrological and husbandry circuit: dew, trough, repeated watering, pasture, lactation, and access can each be the point of arrest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cessation Appears as Dry Rain, Cut Milk, and Denied Access
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rain or milk stops, the final remnant is drawn, an animal or person waits for return, and deprivation names the failed flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rain and milk cut off (`quranic:root_000305:B005/m01`); lactation severed (`quranic:root_000861:B006/m01`); final remnant at cessation (`quranic:root_000861:B007/m01`); waterless isolation (`quranic:root_000861:B010/m01`); hope that milk returns (`quranic:root_001015:B006/m01`); deprivation of provision (`quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`); beneficial wet provision (`quranic:root_000152:B002/m01`); recovery from depletion (`quranic:root_000152:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:17/20/22 forms of `ص ر م` [ص ر م]; 68:25 `حَرْدٍ` [ح ر د]; 68:27 `مَحْرُومُونَ` [ح ر م]; 68:32 `عَسَىٰ` [ع س ي]; surface anchor unavailable for root `ب ل ل`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cessation is not one shortage. It can occur in sky, udder, last draw, isolated terrain, or gatekeeping. The hope in 68:32 is thereby materialized as the uncertain return of a life-sustaining flow.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Boundary Operations Decide What Remains Inside the Whole
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Folding, exception, enclosure, entry, binding, and release all alter membership in a bounded whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The exclusion of the poor is represented as a general boundary technology: a whole can be folded, have a portion excepted, be walled, or be opened by release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Release and Constraint Reverse One Another
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A bound body, legal condition, or guarded thing is either kept under restraint or sent out without remaining liability.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: release from fetter (`quranic:root_000946:B001/m01`); unrestricted permission (`quranic:root_000946:B005/m01`); leather bond or short rope (`quranic:root_000946:B012/m01`); withdrawal from the group (`quranic:root_000305:B004/m01`); preventing or weaning away (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); discursive break and restart (`quranic:root_000152:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:23 `ٱنطَلَقُ` [ط ل ق]; 68:25 `حَرْدٍ` [ح ر د]; 68:33 `عَذَابُ` [ع ذ ب]; surface anchor unavailable for root `ب ل ل`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Constraint and release are inverse boundary operations. A rope keeps the body within a range, law can remove prohibition, withdrawal moves a participant outside the group, and `بَل` cuts one discourse-state to begin another.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The owners’ confident departure is anatomized into distinct failure points: crooked gait, wrong direction, insufficient capacity, or a seeing that cannot identify its own destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Intent Is Calculated Before the Body Moves
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A goal is selected, deliberated, measured against capacity, and converted into an operational plan.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: directed intent and effort (`quranic:root_000305:B001/m01`); anger energizing intent (`quranic:root_000305:B003/m01`); reflective judgment (`quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`); ability and possession (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`); planning by measure (`quranic:root_001205:B005/m02`); proportioned fit (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m01`); divided deliberation (`quranic:root_001226:B006/m02`); cultivated knowledge (`quranic:root_000532:B003/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Purpose is not identical with capacity. Anger can intensify intention, but deliberation, proportion, knowledge, and actual ability must still agree before the plan can reach its object.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Travelers set out freely toward a direction; ease of weather and body may accelerate them, while crooked gait or rough movement disturbs the approach.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: unimpeded departure (`quranic:root_000946:B003/m01`); open face and ease (`quranic:root_000946:B004/m01`); benign travel-time (`quranic:root_000946:B007/m01`); morning movement (`quranic:root_001076:B001/m02`); direction or source (`quranic:root_001198:B003/m01`); capacity to face a force (`quranic:root_001198:B013/m01`); disturbed heavy gait (`quranic:root_000305:B006/m01`); crooked line or building (`quranic:root_000305:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The departure scene distinguishes freedom to leave from ability to arrive. Direction, weather, bodily gait, and confrontational capacity can support or defeat the same declared intention.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Worship Redirects Blame into Redress and Giving
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Corrective speech exonerates the giver, acknowledges wrong, and restores outward movement through worship, acceptance, and generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Praise is not isolated ritual language; it changes the social direction of goods by replacing exclusion and self-justification with accepted fault, protected relation, and largesse.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Praise, Prayer, and Orientation Reorder the Group
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Participants turn toward a worship center, pray or praise, and separate the divine giver from the wrong they committed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prayer, worship, and thanksgiving (`quranic:root_000666:B001/m02`); exoneration and transcendence (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m02`); direction of prayer (`quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`); sacred precinct (`quranic:root_000313:B003/m03`); central position (`quranic:root_001646:B002/m02`); proportioned middle (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Worship spatially and morally reorients the speakers. A common center replaces their closed property-direction, and exoneration distinguishes divine provision from their own disordered use of it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 68:17-33] Life-Cycle Thresholds Can Be Nurtured or Arrested
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Birth, maturation, lactation, and death are thresholds whose continuation depends on care, release, and supply.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The threatened orchard is mirrored by animal and human life cycles: fetus, labor, midwife, milk, grave, and death each show growth either brought through a threshold or deliberately stopped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Grave-Camel Makes Arrested Care Visible
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A camel is tied at its owner’s grave, denied food and water until death, while related senses register stopped milk, immobility, and the end of productive life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: grave-camel left to die (`quranic:root_000153:B005/m01`); tethered burial animal (`quranic:root_000154:B006/m01`); milk and rain stopped (`quranic:root_000305:B005/m02`); camel remaining down at morning (`quranic:root_000839:B008/m02`); grazing camel otherwise released (`quranic:root_000946:B006/m02`); death or killing figured as sleep (`quranic:root_001568:B008/m01`); burial cover (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:17 `بَلَوْ` [ب ل و] and `جَنَّةِ` [ج ن ن]; 68:17/20/21 forms of `ص ب ح` [ص ب ح]; 68:19 `نَآئِمُونَ` [ن و م]; 68:23 `ٱنطَلَقُ` [ط ل ق]; 68:25 `حَرْدٍ` [ح ر د]; surface anchor unavailable for root `ب ل ي`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The grave-camel is a complete counter-husbandry scene: binding replaces release, fasting replaces pasture, and death replaces yield. It intensifies the orchard narrative’s exposure of possession severed from sustaining care.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü tekil ve çoğul biçimleriyle günün erken vaktinde oluşan bulutu tanımlar. Verilen çerçeve hem bulut olma niteliğini hem de oluşma zamanını korur ve bunu genel bulut anlamına yaymaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü günün ilk bölümünde yenilen yemeği çekirdek anlam olarak verir ve buna bağlı yeme eylemi ile yiyen kişiyi de anar. Verilen çerçeve bu katmanları doğru biçimde ayırır ve anlamı bütün yiyeceklere genişletmez.

Bu erken öğünü yeme eylemini anlatan kullanım vardır.
Bu erken öğünü yiyen kişiyi gösteren kullanım vardır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın kesişiminde yemek ve onu tüketme eylemi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir vakitteki öğündür; komşu dal ise vakit ve öğün ayrımı olmadan genel yeme alanını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Günün başında yenilen öğünü ve bu öğünle ilgili kişiyi ya da eylemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Günün başındaki zaman bölümünü ve bu sırada yapılan gidişi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Öğünün adı, komşu dalın gösterdiği erken zaman bölümüne bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir yemektir ve ondan türeyen yeme kullanımlarını kapsar; komşu dal ise zaman ve gidiş kavramıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Verilen çerçevenin çekirdeği, gebe hayvanların karnındaki henüz doğmamış yavrularla kaynak sözüne uyar. Ancak aynı kaynak sözü kapsamı kimi yerde özellikle koyunlara daraltır, beklenen yavru üzerinden yapılan belirsiz satışı ekler ve anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu ya da oğlağa ilişkin ayrı bir kullanım da aktarır; bu öğeler çekirdek tanıma bağımlı katmanlar olarak korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek doğmamış hayvan yavrusudur; satış kullanımı ve anne sütüyle beslenmeyen yavru anlatımı ayrı yan katmanlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kaynakta tek yalın biçime bağlanan doğmamış yavru çekirdeğini, hayvan türü daralmasını, belirsiz satış kullanımını ve aktarılan yan anlamı birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Gebe hayvanların karnındaki henüz doğmamış yavruları, kimi kullanımda özellikle koyunların beklenen yavrularını anlatır. Ayrıca o yılki çiftleşmeden beklenen yavru üzerinden yapılan belirsiz satış için ve ayrı bir aktarımda anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu ya da oğlak için kullanılır.

facets.statement: Gebe hayvanların karnında bulunan henüz doğmamış yavrudur.
Kapsam kimi kullanımda koyunlarla sınırlandırılır, başka anlatımda deve ve koyun yavrularını birlikte içerir.
O yılki çiftleşmeden doğması beklenen yavru üzerine yapılan sonucu belirsiz satışın adıdır.
Ayrı bir aktarım, anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu veya oğlağı bu adla belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı çekirdeği gebe hayvanların karnındaki yavru olarak verir; kapsam bazen koyunlarla sınırlanır, bazen deve ve koyunları birlikte içerir. Aynı anlatım beklenen yavruya dayalı yasaklanmış belirsiz satışı ve anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu ya da oğlak biçimindeki yan aktarımı da korur.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
